aggregate_format_mode_note: ../aggregate-formats.md supersedes earlier aggregate-format exclusions with uniform scalar controls and capture-before-format stages.
evidence: Authored Pythonic extension built from existing checked scalar input and CONFIG-field transports; native whole-aggregate READ acceptance unverified

implemented.order: Capture each root once; declaration fields, row-major ARRAY components and joint axes; flatten CR source-item offsets
implemented.validation: 64 schema levels; 1024 total expanded scalars plus CR; exact schemas/known current values and complete response before scalar publication
implemented.identity: Preserve existing root and child objects; captured old leaves remain selected after host root replacement; repeated aliases last valid value wins
implemented.transports: Typed callback/JSON/TextInput, memory/rooted/device text/binary FILE and cooperative serial/pipe/keyboard input
implemented.lifecycle: Existing pause/resume, cancellation, stop/abort, cursor/status and pending-read guards
